resources.string: Blocks touches from a damaged part of the screen and gives you a trackpad and an on-screen cursor to drive the phone with instead.
1. Allow drawing over other apps, so the blocker, cursor and trackpad can sit above whatever you are using.
2. Turn on the Mouse accessibility service, so the cursor can actually tap things. Find it under Settings › Accessibility › Mouse.
Block touches in the damaged area
Blocked area, measured from the top of the screen
Tap when I lift my finger off the trackpad

On the trackpad: slide to move the cursor, lift to tap, hold to long press. DRAG marks a start point, then move and lift to drag from it. The header bar moves the panel and the − button shrinks it to a puck.
Slide to move · lift to tap · hold to long press
Move only — lifting will not tap
Drag armed — move, then lift to drop
Drag starts at the cursor. Move, then lift to drop.
Mouse needs permission to draw over other apps.
Turn on the Mouse accessibility service first.
That tap could not be delivered.
Shown while the cursor and touch blocker are active.
Touches in the damaged area are blocked.
Lets Mouse tap, long press and drag where you put the on-screen cursor, and use Back, Home and Recents from the floating trackpad. Mouse does not read screen content.
